scene: The friendly kiosk vendor offers you three strange city transit tokens.
picture: Flat side view along a sunlit station concourse. On the far left sits a waiting night tram. Left of centre, a cheerful striped newspaper kiosk stands with an owl vendor. The curly-haired boy in a denim jacket stands at the kiosk counter. On the right, an iron service elevator waits open. Far right sits a heavy freight lift.
shown: A sleek glowing night tram waiting with doors open on the far left
An open iron service elevator cage on the right with buttons lit
A heavy metal freight lift platform with lowered gates on the far right
